title: distinguished-name buffer in pinfo->pool kept by a file-level static whose frame-end reset was registered on a copy of pinfo
live_proof: absent at the 4.6.8 pin by inspection: packet-eap.c no longer carries the pinfo_eapol copy. The pre-fix shape is quoted from a8b16d74e1^ at packet-eap.c:1818-1819 and :2283 (the copy handed to TLS), packet-x509if.c:279 and :911-912 (the static, the allocation and the registration) and packet-x509af.c:323-324 (the read).
object: the x509if distinguished-name string buffer, about 2600 bytes in pinfo->pool
lifetime_ender: epan_dissect_reset between packets (epan.c:591 at the fix's parent); the frame-end routine that would clear the static ran on a discarded copy of pinfo
shape: stale pointer held by a global across packets
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator; the defeated frame-end registration is represented by its effect, a static that is never cleared
distinguishing: the largest object in the corpus, and the only holder whose upstream cleanup existed but was attached to the wrong packet_info; the read is a printf %s over the whole buffer

native-detect.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-native-asan/: **NO ASan REPORT** on the buggy arm, which printed VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, so the defective access ran and ASan did not see it. The fixed arm exits 0 with VERDICT FIXED and no report. Built with the port's own allocator library under the same sanitizer (cc (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 13.3.0; -fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O0; wmem and the port built with the same flags). Positive controls in the same run: `asan-control past 402653184` -> heap-buffer-overflow; `asan-control uaf 402653184` -> heap-use-after-free -- so ASan reports on a heap block the size of this corpus's arena, and the silence is the arena: one malloc'd block, carved and recycled without free(). Predicted before the run (b64cd18b85d0); the arm was previously 'not written'.

cheribsd-revocation.target: stock CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation on
cheribsd-revocation.oracle: the sequence completes: the stale storage is wmem-managed, and a scope reset or an individual recycler free returns it inside a block that malloc still owns, so nothing reaches free() and the quarantine the revoker sweeps never holds it MEASURED 2026-10-07 WITH A REVOCATION CONTROL, results/20261007-cheribsd-revocation-control/: the sequence COMPLETES, NOT CAUGHT. 21 of 21 arms passed, runner exit 0, mode 0 (the port's unprotected baseline, which is the arm that asks what the shipping temporal mechanism does). The control FAULTED in the same boot -- tag_after_sweep=0 reissued=1, then SIGPROT si_code 2 at addr=pc=0x101dc0, equal to the probe address supervise resolved from the ELF independently -- so the revoker is shown to sweep and this completion means 'the mechanism is active and did not fire'. WHY A SECOND RUN: the 20260921-cheribsd bundle measured cases 0-12 at revocation on but contained NO revocation control, only a bounds control and a PoisonCap differential, neither of which shows the revoker sweeps; and it ran on image 3571a6d2..., a different vehicle. This run uses the image byte-identical to the ffmpeg and memcached readings, so the three programs' columns are comparable. The earlier bundle is kept for its PoisonCap arms.
cheribsd-revocation.control: the PoisonCap mode-1 arm in the same bundle and the same boots faults 13/13 with SIGPROT at the labelled read probe, so the platform CAN be made to catch these cases; the completion here is therefore a measured miss and not an absent integration
cheribsd-revocation.measured: 2026-09-21, results/20260921-cheribsd/ (matrix.tsv, arm=cheribsd): expected complete, passed True, exit 0. 0 of 13 caught across the corpus

native-fix-differential.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-09, results/2026-10-09-native-differential/: the buggy sequence reaches storage outside its object (VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, exit 0) and the fixed sequence -- this case's upstream fix, modelled in case.c under wm_fixed -- does not (VERDICT FIXED, exit 0). Hosted build, upstream wmem allocator (WM_CHUNKS=OFF), `program 0 N buggy|fixed` (runners/run-native.sh). Temporal: the next dissection reoccupies the freed storage, asserted to be the same address, and the stale read returns its marker. The arm did not exist before 2026-10-09: the cases had no fixed sequence.
